name: ACG solar and battery (Roofsol)
description: Roofsol will build a 5 MWp solar plant with a 4 MWh battery in Maharashtra and sell its power to Associated Capsules Group, a maker of capsules and pharmaceutical packaging. It is Roofsol's first battery order from a commercial and industrial customer.

sources.title: Roofsol Energy Signs PPA with ACG for 5 MWp Solar and 4 MWh BESS Project in Maharashtra

name: Belagavi wind farm (Blueleaf)
description: The wind farm is in Belagavi district, Karnataka, and has eight years of operating history. It joins Blueleaf Energy's Indian portfolio as an operating asset. Neither the price nor the seller was disclosed.

sources.title: Blueleaf Energy acquires 40MW wind farm in Karnataka

name: EnerSynk 500 MW Solar (Zambia)
description: ZESCO, Zambia's state power utility, will buy the output of a 500 MW solar project from EnerSynk Group, a Hungarian climate infrastructure company, for 25 years. The site, cost and timetable were not disclosed in the announcement.

sources.title: ZESCO Signs 25-Year PPA For 500 MW Solar Project In Zambia

name: Gedong Solar
description: The plant will be built in Gedong, Simunjan District, Samarahan, Sarawak, with 250 MWac of export capacity and up to 363 MWp of panels. The buyer, Syarikat Sesco, is wholly owned by Sarawak Energy. The investment is about RM1 billion.

sources.title: reNIKOLA signs 30-year PPA for 250MW solar project in Malaysia

name: Kilderry Solar Farm
description: Kilderry is a 40 MWp solar project in County Kilkenny, close to several of Elgin's own development sites. Elgin, an independent power producer that builds and runs utility-scale solar and storage, bought it from developer BayWa r.e.

sources.title: Elgin acquires Kilderry solar farm from BayWa r.e.

name: Macchiareddu Solar
description: An operating 46.5 MW solar plant in the province of Cagliari, Sardinia. Sonnedix bought it in 2026 from a fund managed by EOS IM, together with the 7.5 MW Aprilia plant in Lazio.

sources.title: Sonnedix acquires two solar photovoltaics assets in Italy totalling 54 MW

name: NCRTC Jaulan Captive Solar
description: The 110 MW captive solar plant will be built at Jaulan, Uttar Pradesh, by NIRL NCRTC Renewables, a company linked to NLC India Renewables. It is estimated to cost about ₹450 crore, funded 80% debt and 20% equity, and is due within 24 months.

sources.title: NCRTC Signs PPA for 110 MW Captive Solar Plant to Power Delhi–Meerut Namo Bharat Corridor

name: Neftchala Solar PV
description: The 315 MW plant is in Neftchala district and is co-developed with Azerbaijan's Ministry of Energy. Lenders are the AIIB, the EBRD and the ADB. It is expected to produce more than 686 million kWh a year. Masdar also signed an agreement with the Azerbaijan Green Energy Company to study expanding its 230 MW Garadagh plant by at least 350 MW with up to 200 MWh of batteries.

sources.title: Masdar and SOCAR Green Secure Financial Close for 315 MW Neftchala Solar Project in Azerbaijan

name: Pedersöre BESS
description: The two batteries were developed by Ingrid Capacity: Pedersöre in Finland, 45 MW / 90 MWh and ready to build, which has an offtake agreement, and Vaggeryd in Sweden. Together they total 145 MW / 290 MWh. Mirova's €65 million is an equity investment.

sources.title: Mirova invests €65 million in Nordic battery storage developed by Ingrid Capacity

name: Ras Shokeir Wind
description: The Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company will buy the power from the 1 GW Ras Shokeir wind project in the Red Sea Governorate. The project company, Ras Shokeir Wind Energy Co., is owned by a consortium of Infinity Power and Hassan Allam Utilities Energy. The wind farm will be spread over about 143 km².

sources.title: Infinity Power and Hassan Allam Utilities Energy sign PPA for Egyptian wind project

name: San Matías Solar PV

debt.name: Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development

description: The KWD 3 million (about US$9.6 million) loan from the Kuwait Fund goes to the Government of El Salvador. It funds an 11 MWp solar plant at Hacienda San Lorenzo in San Matías, north-west of San Salvador, on about 108,000 m² of land leased for 25 years. The plant should produce 20–25 GWh a year.

sources.title: Kuwait Fund Provides USD 9.6 Million Loan for 11 MW San Matías Solar Project in El Salvador
